subject: Re: CAIQ evidence custody log & rotation sprint
messages:
From: Samuel Kline <samuel.kline@harborhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HarborHealth Security <security@harborhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: evidence custody / rotation schedule (initial ask)

Hi Chloe —

Thanks again for the CAIQ response packet you shared last week. As part of our internal audit, we need a short-form custody ledger for the artifacts you plan to hand off (log samples, runtime screenshots, key rotation records). Specifically:

- A single CSV/ledger that lists artifact name, owner, storage location, retention classification, and last-access timestamp.
- A rotation schedule for sample artifacts (we sample different tenants each quarter).
- Confirmation of how artifacts are redacted before we share (PII masking steps).

Can you send a proposed ledger template and an initial 2-week sprint plan for capturing/rotating the evidence? We have an internal deadline of 2027-06-25 for intake.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Kline
Sr. Security Program Manager, HarborHealth
security@harborhealth.com

Attachments: harbor_caiq_scope.xlsx (requested CAIQ scope sheet)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Kline <samuel.kline@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: evidence custody / rotation schedule (initial ask)

Sam —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a custody ledger template (CSV) and a compact 10-working-day "rotation sprint" plan for producing the initial sample bundle. High-level answers below:

- Ledger: CSV columns include artifact_id, friendly_name, control_id_owner, storage_uri, retention_category, redaction_status, collector, last_collected_at, verification_signature.
- Rotation cadence: weekly collection for first two weeks (to cover peak tails), then quarterly sampling thereafter. We will stage artifacts in a locked S3 bucket with time-limited presigned URLs for sharing.
- Redaction: automated PII redaction pipeline runs prior to snapshot export (hashing + field-level redaction); manual review for any flagged entries.

I've looped in Marissa (evidence ops) and Neha (control owners) to assign owners and validate the storage proofs. We'll aim to deliver the first bundle by 2027-06-23 to give you a two-day buffer before your intake window.

Quick note: we'll include a small "verification proof" (s3-proof-screenshot.png) and a signed custody log entry in the CSV for each artifact.

Chloe
Chloe Martin
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: evidence-custody-ledger-template.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: evidence custody / rotation schedule (initial ask)

Adding ops detail and owner commitments.

- Storage proof: we'll capture an S3 console screenshot (signed) and an object-metadata export (md5/hash + last-modified). Screenshot attached for reference.
- Verification flow: each ledger row will have a "verifier" field (ops engineer) and a verification_token. Verifier signs off in the CSV and we keep the sign-off in our internal audit S3 prefix (read-only).
- Sample selection: Neha, can you confirm which controls we should prioritize for the first sprint? My recommendation: CAM-01 (access logs), NET-03 (network segmentation evidence), and LOG-02 (retention proofs).

I'll reserve time on 2027-06-16 for a 30-min runthrough with Sam if that helps finalize the sample list.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Evidence Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00

Confirmed — prioritized control list below and sample artifact mapping.

- CAM-01 (Auth & Access): sample = IAM policy snapshot (policy_dump_20270614.json), login event tail (last 7 days). Redaction: mask usernames to hash(user) for shared copies.
- LOG-02 (Retention & Logging): sample = retention-policy-doc.pdf, log-archive-sample.tar.gz (contains only anonymized session ids).
- NET-03 (Network): sample = vpc-segmentation-diagram.pdf, fw-rule-export.csv (sensitive IPs redacted).

Owner assignments:
- CAM-01: Neha (control owner) / ops verifier: Marissa
- LOG-02: Chloe (control owner) / ops verifier: Marissa
- NET-03: Neha / ops verifier: Marissa

Deadlines: initial artifact capture by 2027-06-21; verification & CSV signing by 2027-06-23; deliver to HarborHealth (presigned URL) by 2027-06-23 EOD PT.

I will prepare the policy dump and schedule an automated redaction run on 2027-06-18.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Controls Owner, Redwood Inference
